matches.match: Queens Park Rangers vs Derby County
matches.analysis: Prices: QPR 1.75 / Draw 3.60 / Derby 4.20. Over 2.5 1.80 / Under 2.5 2.00; BTTS Yes 1.70 / No 2.05. Derby have lost three in a row, have six players out (Agyemang, Forsyth, Murkin, Clarke, Zetterstrom, Taylor) and Bilbija and Meister are doubtful. QPR have drawn four of their last five league games, though, and miss Chair, Dembele and Kone. Derby +1 is priced about 1.65, which is fair, and QPR at 1.75 leaves no margin. No bet.

Prices: Portsmouth 2.20 / Draw 3.30 / Sheffield United 3.00. Over 2.5 1.91 / Under 2.5 1.91; BTTS Yes 1.75 / No 1.95. Prices: Norwich 2.40 / Draw 3.50 / Southampton 2.60. Over 2.5 1.50 / Under 2.5 2.62; BTTS Yes 1.44 / No 2.62. Norwich have seven players out (Toure, McLean, Ahmed, Mahovo, Topic, Diallo, Chrisene), have kept only 42% of their XI over the last six games and have won once in five. Southampton are settled (82% of the XI kept, same eleven two games running), are 8-4 up in the 17 meetings and won 1-0 at Portsmouth on Sunday, with Cyle Larin on 9 league goals. Bragg is suspended and Jander is doubtful, which is why this is a small bet. Norwich are the favourites on price only, so Southampton at 2.60 is the value. Take 2.50 or better. The stake is 1%.

matches.match: Lincoln City vs West Ham United
matches.analysis: Prices: Lincoln 4.50 / Draw 4.00 / West Ham 1.65. Over 2.5 1.67 / Under 2.5 2.20; BTTS Yes 1.70 / No 2.05. West Ham are third and have scored 23 in nine games (2.6 a game) with a goal difference of +11, and they are unbeaten away with one win and three draws. Lincoln are 16th, have scored only seven in nine (0.8 a game), have not won at home this season (two draws, two defeats) and have not won away either. Areola and Soucek are doubtful for West Ham and Lamadrid and Veltman are out, but the squad is deep. West Ham at 1.65 is a better price than their attack against Lincoln's record deserves. Take 1.60 or better. The stake is 1.5%.
